top.query:
SELECT s.id, s.seat_id AS seatId, p.seat_number AS seatNumber,
    CASE WHEN s.status = 'HELD' AND r.expires_at <= clock_timestamp()
         THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE s.status END AS status
FROM tbooker.show_seats s JOIN tbooker.seats p ON p.id = s.seat_id
LEFT JOIN tbooker.reservations r ON r.show_seat_id = s.id AND r.status = 'HELD'
WHERE s.show_id = $1 ORDER BY p.seat_number, s.id

INSERT INTO tbooker.payments (user_id, reservation_id, method, amount_minor, currency,
	idempotency_key, gateway_request_id, status, confirmation_status, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, 'INR', $5, $6, 'PENDING', 'NOT_READY', $7, $8)
ON CONFLICT ON CONSTRAINT uq_payments_owner_key DO NOTHING

UPDATE tbooker.outbox_events SET status='PUBLISHED',published_at=clock_timestamp(),
    lease_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL,last_error=NULL
WHERE event_id=$1 AND status='IN_FLIGHT' AND lease_token=$2

UPDATE tbooker.reservations SET status = 'CONFIRMED', booking_id = $1, confirmed_payment_id = $2
WHERE id = $3 AND user_id = $4 AND status = 'HELD' AND expires_at > $5

UPDATE tbooker.payments SET status = $1, provider_reference = $2, provider_version = $3,
	confirmation_status = CASE WHEN $4 = 'SUCCESS' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'NOT_READY' END,
	updated_at = clock_timestamp()
WHERE id = $5 AND provider_version < $6 AND status <> 'SUCCESS'
UPDATE tbooker.payments SET confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED', updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'SUCCESS'

INSERT INTO tbooker.processed_events(consumer_name,event_id,booking_id,payload_hash)
VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

select r1_0.id,b1_0.id,b1_0.created_at,b1_0.show_seat_id,b1_0.status,b1_0.user_id,r1_0.confirmed_payment_id,r1_0.created_at,r1_0.expires_at,r1_0.show_seat_id,ss2_0.id,ss2_0.show_id,ms1_0.id,ms1_0.movie_id,ms1_0.screen_id,ms1_0.start_time,ss2_0.screen_id,ss2_0.seat_id,ss2_0.status,r1_0.status,r1_0.user_id from tbooker.reservations r1_0 join tbooker.users u1_0 on u1_0.id=r1_0.user_id left join tbooker.bookings b1_0 on b1_0.id=r1_0.booking_id join tbooker.show_seats ss2_0 on ss2_0.id=r1_0.show_seat_id join tbooker.movie_shows ms1_0 on ms1_0.id=ss2_0.show_id where r1_0.id=$1 and u1_0.id=$2
UPDATE tbooker.show_seats SET status = 'HELD' WHERE id = $1 AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
SELECT id FROM tbooker.show_seats WHERE id = $1 FOR UPDATE
select count(*) from tbooker.movie_shows ms1_0 where ms1_0.id=$1

INSERT INTO tbooker.mock_gateway_receipts
	(request_id, method, amount_minor, currency, provider_reference, status, version)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, 1) ON CONFLICT (request_id) DO NOTHING
